snippet.title: SAVE AMANI - 2.5D Stealth - Gameplay (PC)
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3153280/SAVE_AMANI/
SAVE AMANI is a war adventure game. Players help a child named AMANI escape danger by solving puzzles. The game conveys war's cruelty, awakening appreciation for peace and concern for children in war, and the harm to lives and souls. "Amani" means "peace" in Swahili.
